claim: A transition drawn through a separate effect (a dissolve) can drop the colour layer if the build switches layers off for it; repeat the effect's passes on the colour layer instead.
limit: The simulator proves the end result, not how the passes look.

evidence.text: Views shown by the dissolve (the drawbridge) stayed in the original look because the dissolve 0xB66E turns Layer 2 and sprites off; now drawn hidden, 0xB66E's passes repeated on Layer 2 (h_dpass), then flipped; m3_sim 18 / 18 such views.
evidence.quote: passes repeated on Layer 2 (site 0xB6E4 h_dpass), then flipped: +3 frames. m3_sim: 18 / 18 such views.
